# `pinch`

Two-finger pinch around a point, in device pixels (element-bounds units). A larger endSpan than startSpan spreads the fingers apart (zoom in); a smaller one pinches them together (zoom out). Android only.

## Source

- Kind: class-backed
- Class: `xyz.block.trailblaze.toolcalls.commands.PinchTrailblazeTool`

## Contract

- Visible to LLM: yes (`surface_to_llm: true`)
- Recordable: yes (`is_recordable: true`)
- Host-only: no (`requires_host: false`)

## Input schema

### Required parameters

- `x` — `Integer`
  X coordinate of the pinch center.
- `y` — `Integer`
  Y coordinate of the pinch center.
- `startSpan` — `Integer`
  Distance between the two fingers when they touch down, in pixels.
- `endSpan` — `Integer`
  Distance between the two fingers when they lift, in pixels.

### Optional parameters

- `angleDegrees` — `Integer`
  Angle of the line through both fingers: 0 = horizontal, 90 = vertical.
- `durationMs` — `Integer`
  How long the gesture takes, in ms. Default: scaled to the span change (about 1.5 px of span per ms, 150 to 600 ms), because some map views ignore a pinch that changes the span too slowly.
